The charge fluctuations sqrt(<DN^2>) = 37 (S61 Ginzburg result) mean that the reduced density matrix after partial trace over one cell explores the full (n1 = 0, 1, 1, 2) sector space of the 2-pair, 2-cell Hilbert space.
